# Rocky Mountain Kids Dentistry

> > Specialized pediatric dental care in Englewood, CO, providing comprehensive services from preventive wellness to emergency care for children of all ages and healthcare needs.

Rocky Mountain Kids Dentistry is a pediatric dental practice in Englewood, Colorado, led by experienced dentists including Dr. Lane Bland, Dr. Carissa Molina, and Dr. Heather Jenkins. The practice offers preventive care, restorative treatments, emergency services, and specialized care for children with special healthcare needs.

## Preventive & Wellness Services

- [Dental Wellness](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/englewood-co/dental-wellness): Preventive dental wellness services including x-rays, fluoride, sealants
- [Digital X-Rays for Kids](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/englewood-co/low-radiation-digital-dental-x-rays): Low-radiation digital x-ray imaging technology for pediatric patients
- [Fluoride Treatments for Kids](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/englewood-co/fluoride-treatments): Fluoride treatments for cavity prevention and enamel strengthening
- [Dental Sealants for Kids](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/englewood-co/sealants): Dental sealants reducing tooth decay risk by up to 80% for children
- [Sports Guards](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/englewood-co/sports-guards): Custom sports guards for athletic injury prevention in children

## Restorative & Treatment Services

- [Dental Restorations](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/englewood-co/dental-restorations): Dental restoration services including fillings, crowns, and bondings
- [Tooth Colored Fillings](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/englewood-co/tooth-colored-fillings): Composite resin tooth-colored fillings for cavity treatment in children
- [Biocompatible Stainless Steel Crowns](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/englewood-co/biocompatible-stainless-steel-crowns): Biocompatible stainless steel and zirconia crowns for baby teeth
- [Bondings](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/englewood-co/bondings): Dental bonding with composite resin for tooth repair and restoration

## Specialized Care

- [All Services](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/services): Overview of dental services including sedation options and emergency care
- [Special Healthcare Needs](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/englewood-co/special-healthcare-needs): Specialized dental care for children with special healthcare needs
- [Emergency Dental Care](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/englewood-co/emergency-dental-care): Emergency dental care for tooth pain, trauma, and abscesses in children
